name: Capability Fabric
actions: validate a reviewed exact capability build request
resolve one digest-bound source-reviewed recipe or return a typed hold
compile one detached complete capability candidate by default
emit focused tests without executing generated code
materialize exact Nursery-compatible candidates through explicit CLI or browser download
inspect future recipe proposals without activating them
summary: A deterministic Workshop how-layer that compiles reviewed requests through exact recipes into detached code, creation-hand, and adapter candidates without ongoing model compute.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL only. Imported proposals require the inactive draft schema. Builds execute no generated code; verification refuses rehashed authority drift; and no installation, promotion, Foundation, or CANON authority is granted.
